body: Continuation of the S006 line: the owner ruled the mid-loop consult never actually thinks — it performs an inner voice on demand (roleplay prose streamed as thought), while the reference harness records the model's native per-step reasoning verbatim. Scope: make the consult stream the native reasoning channel only and answer JSON-only; no authored prose is ever shown as thought. Touching backend/src/core/agent/thinker/ (thinker, prompt, parse), one comment block in backend/src/core/agent/loop.py, and the thinker tests.
